style_context: Competitive video gaming, esports broadcasting, hardware engineering, and digital citizenship

images.description: A clean modern gaming desk setup featuring dual high-refresh-rate monitors on desk arms, a mechanical keyboard with subtle RGB backlight, an ergonomic gaming mouse, cable management channels, and a padded headset on a desk stand.
images.value: Shows the spatial arrangement of a dual-monitor ergonomic desk setup — equipment layout details text alone cannot convey.

images.description: Side-by-side split screen image comparing video gaming formats. Left side shows a casual living room with friends playing on a couch in front of a TV screen. Right side shows a professional esports tournament stage with players wearing headsets at PCs, stage lighting, and referees.
images.value: Split-frame contrast of casual living room gaming vs an organized stage esports environment with referee, team headsets, and audience screens — highlights structural elements text cannot convey.

images.description: Close-up view of a gaming video display overlay menu showing player profile options with clear callouts highlighting the Mute, Block, and Report Player buttons.
images.value: Annotated player action menu showing exact locations of Mute, Block, and Report buttons on a game UI overlay — menu positioning that text cannot teach clearly.

images.description: Clean educational diagram of proper computer desk ergonomic posture. Vector style graphic showing a person seated with labeled checkpoints: Monitor Top at Eye Level, 90 degree elbow bend, Lumbar Back Support, Neutral Wrist Position, Feet Flat on Floor.
images.value: Labeled ergonomic posture diagram showing exact angles for monitor height, neutral wrist alignment, 90-degree elbow bend, and lumbar support — posture details text alone cannot illustrate.

images.description: Step-by-step educational diagram showing Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) account security flow. Panel 1: Password entry on computer monitor. Panel 2: Mobile smartphone receiving 6-digit authenticator verification code. Panel 3: Account Access Approved green checkmark shield icon.
images.value: Step-by-step security flow showing primary password authentication combined with mobile authenticator approval — teaches 2FA verification steps text cannot easily show.

images.description: Exploded technical diagram layout of custom desktop gaming PC hardware components. Clear labels for CPU Processor, GPU Graphics Card, Motherboard, RAM Memory Sticks, SSD Storage Drive, and Power Supply Unit.
images.value: Exploded layout showing spatial positioning and connection sockets of CPU, GPU, RAM modules, motherboard, and power supply — teaches hardware component relationships text cannot convey.

images.description: Educational layout diagram showing an esports live stream broadcast interface layout. Clear labels pointing to Main Gameplay View, Player Webcams, Mini-Map Corner, Score & Timer Banner, and Shoutcaster Desk Window.
images.value: Annotated broadcast overlay diagram showing match feed, player webcams, mini-map, score tickers, and shoutcaster picture-in-picture box — teaches esports production layout text cannot show.
